answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Licensed private investigator case file with private investigators confirmation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 754 fakes spends 12064 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The cipher sits in the mechanism itself, the haven sits in the price of faking it, and the ocean sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
